compartment.title: Batch 5 CLI commands — implementation and export fixes
compartment.p1:
Continued Batch 5 CLI secrets commands implementation on `feature/phase-10-secret-injection`. Read secrets provider types, CLI tsconfig, and root tsconfig to understand type compatibility across packages. Rewrote the secrets command file with all fixes applied, then ran type-check on the CLI package. Used glob and grep on `packages/secrets/src/**/*.d.ts` to verify type outputs. Wrote a new types file under `packages/secrets/src/types/` to resolve the `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` incompatibility with partial config objects — the constructor options pattern was needed to fix type errors.
The three issues from the initial implementation (cloud provider barrel exports, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` partial config, `ApplePMConfig` field name `service` vs `cliPath`) were being fully resolved in this pass.
compartment.p2: Batch 5 CLI secrets commands continued: read provider types and tsconfigs, rewrote command file with fixes, type-checked CLI package. Fixed exactOptionalPropertyTypes partial config issue via constructor options pattern in a new types file under `packages/secrets/src/types/`. Cloud provider exports, ApplePMConfig field name, and config type issues from initial wiring all resolved.
compartment.p3: Batch 5 CLI secrets commands implementation and type fixes completed on `feature/phase-10-secret-injection`. exactOptionalPropertyTypes incompatibility resolved via constructor options pattern.
